You trace the edge of the strange place, watching for the seam where its magic catches the light.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Reason
Time
Ten minutes.
Target / range / shape
A 3-by-3 visible area within 5 squares; 10 minutes examination
Duration
Information and earned progress persist for the stated task; completed changes remain until circumstances alter them.
Equipment / acquisition
None.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Magic

If several concealments are present, the DA chooses one relevant to your stated search; all results describe that same concealment.

Weak
Reveal one magical concealment’s presence, if any.
Standard
Also reveal its location.
Strong
Also reveal one activation or bypass requirement.
